summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its June 15, 2026 annual meeting of common shareholders. Resolutions approved included election of five director nominees (each receiving over 99% votes for), reappointment of BDO Canada LLP as auditor (99.998% for), adoption of a new omnibus equity incentive plan (91.236% for), and approval of unallocated awards under the existing stock option plan (91.236% for). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. The filing is a routine reporting of annual meeting results, which does not constitute a special situation.
